question: Why Hume?
name: question_11483395008
value: I have run Kubernetes on AWS at scale for 8 years: 400 microservices on EKS at Acme Cloud, where I cut incident time by 40 percent with Datadog and OpenTelemetry. I built the Terraform platform used by 120 engineers and led an on-call rotation of 8 people. Before that, at Beta Systems, I migrated 60 services to Kubernetes and introduced SLOs and error budgets. What draws me to Hume is the infrastructure side of model work: distributed training, inference and benchmarking at industry scale, where reliability decides how fast research can move. I want to build that foundation for speech-language models. • Add: any model training, fine-tuning or evaluation work you have done with PyTorch or similar, with the data scale. • Add: publications or open-source contributions to language, audio or video models, if you have any.
